items.title: The Clampetts Strike Oil
items.subtitle: The Beverly Hillbillies · S1 E1 · ~25m
items.overview: The pilot starts after the theme song when Jed struck oil in his Lake. A rural Ozark family relocates to Beverly Hills after oil is discovered on their property worth $25 million. After finding oil on the land, the family is surprised when Mr. Brewster of the OK Oil Company offers to buy it. After much coaxing by Cousin Pearl, Jed sells the swamp and moves the family to a mansion in Beverly Hills. Upon their arrival, they are arrested because of a case of mistaken identity but are later returned to the mansion safely.

items.title: Getting Settled
items.subtitle: The Beverly Hillbillies · S1 E2 · ~25m
items.overview: The Clampetts begin to settle in their new home in Beverly Hills. They are having to adjust to things such as refrigerators, ovens and the "cement pond" (swimming pool). Jethro also encounters a flamingo that he thinks is a chicken (which causes Jed to suspect Jethro has been sneaking drinks of moonshine). Meanwhile, Miss Hathaway, executive secretary to banker Milburn Drysdale, mistakes the Clampetts for "domestic" help. She thinks Granny is a cook and Elly a maid.

notices.title: TMDB metadata
notices.text: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Title metadata, cast, crew and user ratings are offline snapshots delivered by the Rust core from the mock API, not live scores. TMDB data and branding are not public-domain or Creative Commons artwork. Developer API use is non-commercial; commercial use needs separate permission.

notices.title: Mock catalog
notices.text: Jellyfin is not connected. Listing links show catalog presence, not streaming availability. Continue Watching progress, Up Next and addition order are simulated offline fixture state, not watch history or real provider state. No video files or playback are included. These films span family animation, adult comedy and horror; no age certification is implied.

notices.title: Artwork
notices.text: Artwork, portraits, character stills and the approved TMDB logo are served by the configured mock endpoint and loaded through the Rust core. Clients may crop artwork for display. Missing artwork may use abstract placeholders or initials; failed requests must not be replaced with fixture data.

notices.title: Film & episode rights
notices.text: Sprite Fright retains its original 2021 Blender release year. TMDB lists the same film as 2024-04-06; the snapshot preserves that provider date separately. The import verifies TMDB title 891761 through director Matthew Luhn and the official Blender film homepage, not a loose title/year match.

Public domain is jurisdiction-specific. Original film rights do not cover every restoration, new score, edition, poster, trademark or separate musical work. Verify edition and local rights before reuse. No license is asserted for the complete television series.
